spec.name: Orange Kitchen Salmon Nigiri
spec.description: Two plump salmon nigiri on a low charcoal ceramic plate. Stepped ivory rice supports thick coral salmon with softly drooping ends, cream fat ribbons and restrained fresh highlights. Plate rests at y=0.

prompt: Orange SMP Kitchen cohesive premium Minecraft vanilla voxel art. Appetizing recognizable silhouette and deliberate connected pixel shading, material detail and highlights. No plain untextured cubes, random noise, letters or scenery. Use ONE well-mapped 64x64 atlas; per-face UV islands, not repeated generic material tiles. Keep texture palette cohesive: warm golden bread, fresh greens, ivory rice, rich salmon, warm ceramics. Geometry should be carefully stepped and rounded where appropriate, with purposeful tiny details. 20-55 cuboids as appropriate, stay within Java model bounds -16..32. Item ground bottom y0. Strong inventory readability. Create Salmon Nigiri. Two hand-shaped stepped rice mounds with draped fish slices; salmon stripes if appropriate; small dark ceramic plate. Actual recipe ingredients: sushi rice, salmon slice. Let the visible appearance reflect these ingredients.
